events.name: Rockslide!
events.description: The ground trembles and rocks cascade down the mountainside!

success.description: You dive out of the way just in time. Dust settles around you.

failure.description: Rocks slam into you before you can dodge!

events.name: Mountain Hermit
events.description: A weathered old hermit sits cross-legged on a rocky outcrop. 'Sit, adventurer. I have wisdom to share... for a price.'

choices.description: The hermit reveals the surrounding terrain on your map.

success.description: Impressed by your charm, the hermit blesses you freely.

failure.description: The hermit snorts. 'Charisma won't buy bread.' You move on.

events.name: Eagle's Nest
events.description: You spot a massive eagle's nest on a nearby ledge. Something sparkles within.

success.description: You carefully climb to the nest and find a golden trinket!

failure.description: The mother eagle returns! Her talons rake your arm as you scramble away.

events.name: Bandit Camp
events.description: Smoke rises from behind a rocky outcrop. You've stumbled upon a bandit hideout!

failure.description: A bandit spots you! 'Intruder!' they cry.

events.name: Crystal Spring
events.description: A pristine spring bubbles from the rock, its water shimmering with magical energy.

choices.description: The water is cool and refreshing. You feel rejuvenated.

events.name: Collapsed Mine Entrance
events.description: You find the entrance to an old mine, partially blocked by rubble. Strange sounds echo from within.

success.description: You clear enough rubble to squeeze through and find abandoned mining supplies!

failure.description: The rubble shifts dangerously. Best not to risk it.

events.name: Sudden Storm
events.description: Dark clouds roll in fast. Lightning cracks across the sky and the wind howls!

success.description: You find shelter in a rocky overhang and wait out the storm.

failure.description: Caught in the open, the storm batters you mercilessly.
